name: NeveN
source:
Embark on a journey in the universe of NeveN, a visual novel set in a medieval-fantasy world where a race of anthropomorphic animals, the anthroken, live, fight, and love. You will follow Erik, a young white rabbit who travels through the kingdom of Frostfang in order to participate in a competition that will see the winner become royal bard. In a world where everyone has a magical ability linked to the gods, called the brand, Erik is one of the few who did not receive it at adulthood.

Explore a living, realistic world where politics mixes court intrigues and religious conflicts.

Play a protagonist with a strong and eccentric personality as you discover the world of NeveN.

Meet the different inhabitants of the world of Telsan. Meet Tenoch, a lizard wielding fire and heir of the empire or Maelbjorn, the cunning bear prince of Frostfang. Create alliances, make friendships, and more!

[From [url=https://neven-vn.itch.io/neven]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏上NeveN宇宙的旅程，这是一部以中世纪奇幻世界为背景的视觉小说，在那里，一群拟人化的动物、人类生活、战斗和爱情。你将跟随埃里克，一只年轻的白兔，穿越霜牙王国，参加一场比赛，获胜者将成为皇家吟游诗人。在这个世界上，每个人都拥有与神灵相关的神奇能力，称为品牌，埃里克是少数在成年后没有获得这种能力的人之一。

探索一个鲜活、现实的世界，其中政治交织着宫廷阴谋和宗教冲突。

扮演性格坚强而古怪的主角，探索NeveN的世界。

认识Telsan世界的不同居民。来认识特诺克（Tenoch），一只挥舞火焰的蜥蜴，帝国的继承人，或者梅比约恩（Maelbjorn），狡猾的霜牙熊王子。建立联盟、结交友谊等等！

[来自[url=https://neven-vn.itch.io/neven]Itch.io[/url]]
